# Pandamonium v1.0.43

Connected MCP discovery remains available when a request names a service behind a broker. The agent work-budget scale is now 20 / 40 / 80 / 120 / 200 rounds, with 80 as the installation default.

## MAD-842 — Integrations: make MAD MCP Portal tools native and unify connection identity

### Problem

A request for records in an external collection could receive no tools or fall back to the internal knowledge index. The resulting citations could be real while still referring to the wrong source. Raising the work budget did not fix that routing problem: the observed default run made no tool calls and the maximum run made only one internal-index search.

### Implementation

The host mounts bounded read-only entrypoints named in each connected MCP server's live initialize guidance, without requiring the user to name the broker. Such discovery prevents an unknown-domain request from taking the no-tools shortcut and survives local-model schema selection. Explicit connection selection retains its existing boundary. Internal knowledge results identify their source and backend; the tool description and model contract distinguish background retrieval from reading a requested external source.

### Product value and UI visibility

The five-position Agent work budget slider now offers Low 20, Medium 40, High 80, Very high 120 and Maximum 200 rounds. Reset uses the installation default of 80, equal to the previous Maximum. These are round ceilings, not model reasoning levels; successful turns still finish early. Native Codex reasoning choices remain unchanged.

### Verification

Agent-loop regressions exercise named-connection and service-only requests through both local-model and API-model paths, checking mounted schemas, real MCP dispatch, argument correction and returned citations with deterministic fixtures. Additional checks cover read-only discovery bounds, disconnected servers, internal-index provenance and settings migration. Browser coverage checks all five slider values and the native Codex controls. Required CI and signed artifact verification gate publication.

### Configuration, compatibility, and limitations

The old saved default of 20 upgrades once to 80. Other custom caps remain intact, and saving 20 explicitly after the upgrade retains it. No dependencies, database schema or authentication changes. Discovery uses the configured server's declared entrypoints and existing authority policy; it does not duplicate provider catalogs. Real-model tool use still requires installed acceptance: fixtures verify the host path, not model reliability. MAD-842 remains open for configured external-record and Discord reads. Installation remains operator-owned.
